_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds, `provides` what it brings beyond its vocabulary.
name: calm
summary: The FINOS Common Architecture Language Model as an architecture framework for the architecture pack: the adapter that reads a CALM 1.x model into the graph (estate nodes with external_id, external_type and external_payload, relationships, controls and flows as nodes, the estate's edges derived beside them) and writes the graph back as CALM, chosen by `oto arch import --framework calm`; and the migration of a graph written with CALM's former attribute names. A pack of the registry, with its code: the engine ships no framework (ADR-0008).

changelog.note: Out of the engine (ADR-0008): the adapter lives in this pack's code/ as the module oto_calm, loaded through this manifest; the engine ships no framework adapter. Needs OTO 0.14.2, the first engine that loads a pack's code.

First release (ADR-0006, step 3): the CALM reader and writer, moved out of the engine's arch module behind the architecture pack's neutral attributes; aligned with CALM 1.0, core schema unchanged through 1.3. Adds no term of its own: CALM maps onto the reified model.
